settings.title: System configuration
settings.subtitle: Manage active business parameters, Board voting rules, and reader-vote fraud protection.

app.title: Business parameters
app.description: Shared operational thresholds; server caches may take up to 30 seconds to refresh.

board.title: Board rules
board.description: Configure total Board membership, the default roster size and approval majority. Session quorum is calculated automatically as two thirds of its roster.
board.lockNotice: Board configuration cannot be changed while a session is ACTIVE or UPCOMING.

voting.title: Reader voting configuration
voting.description: Control OTP/CAPTCHA authentication, request limits, and anti-fraud activation conditions.

errors.validation: One or more configuration values are invalid.
errors.boardLocked: Board configuration is locked because a session is active or upcoming.
errors.notFound: The active configuration could not be found.

loadError.title: Unable to load system configuration
loadError.description: Check your connection and Super Admin permissions, then try again.

operations.title: Business operations
operations.subtitle: Inspect cross-role data and perform platform operations reserved for Super Admins.

notice.title: These actions affect the whole platform
notice.description: Verify the target voting period or series before saving. Changes here may affect rankings and publication editions.

monitoring.title: Business monitoring
monitoring.description: Inspect series, revision rounds, reprint requests, and deadlines without exposing state-changing actions.
monitoring.subtitle: Read-only operational data for investigation and incident support.
monitoring.deadlineHint: Select a series and chapter to review its deadline requests.
monitoring.loadError: The monitoring data could not be loaded completely. Please try again.

surveys.title: Reader voting periods
surveys.description: Create a voting period for a magazine issue, control its state, import offline votes, and finalize rankings.

publicationVersions.title: Publication versions
publicationVersions.description: Create, update, or delete series language editions and reading directions.

reference.title: Operational reference data
reference.description: Inspect production, ranking, directory, reprint, deadline and transfer evidence across the platform.
reference.downloadFailed: The protected download link could not be created.

workspace.title: Operations workspace
workspace.description: Choose the area that matches your investigation or intervention goal.

surveyWorkspace.title: Reader voting period control
surveyWorkspace.description: Each period covers an entire magazine issue rather than a single series. A Super Admin opens and closes voting, imports offline data, and publishes the final ranking.
surveyWorkspace.scope: Set the magazine issue and eligible series
surveyWorkspace.authority: Open or close voting at the right time
surveyWorkspace.finalization: Review the data and publish the ranking

boardOversight.title: Board administration
boardOversight.subtitle: Monitor Board activity and use administrative privileges only when the Editor or Board Member workflow encounters a problem.

notice.title: These are fallback intervention privileges
notice.description: A Super Admin does not attend or vote as a Board Member. Let the Editor operate the session and intervene only when the workflow must be restored.

roleBoundary.title: Responsibility boundary
roleBoundary.description: Editors create and operate sessions; Board Members discuss, vote, and approve; Super Admins monitor and restore a workflow when an incident occurs.

editor.title: Editor coordinates
editor.description: Prepares evidence, creates the session, and manages its progress.

board.title: Board decides
board.description: Discusses, votes, and performs Board approvals.

admin.title: Super Admin oversees
admin.description: Monitors, traces, and provides fallback intervention.

tools.title: Oversight and intervention tools
tools.description: Each area clearly identifies its operating mode to prevent role confusion.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Review session state and supporting material without changing the business workflow.

intervention.title: Incident intervention
intervention.description: These tools can change business data and should only be used when necessary.

sessions.title: Board sessions
sessions.description: Monitor upcoming, active, and concluded sessions; advance a phase if the session creator cannot act.

reports.title: Board reports
reports.description: Read series analysis reports prepared for Board decisions.

decisions.title: Board decisions
decisions.description: Inspect and restore Board decision flows when the normal workflow is interrupted.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle decisions
lifecycle.description: Intervene in cancellation, hiatus, completion, or publication-format decisions.

payments.title: Payment handling
payments.description: Monitor and pay or cancel payment records; approval remains a Board Member responsibility.

audit.title: System activity history
audit.subtitle: See who affected which object, how its state changed, and when each event occurred.
audit.empty: No activity matches the current filters.

filters.title: Filter activity history
filters.description: Filter by object type or action; use technical identifiers only when investigating a specific event.

loadError.title: Unable to load activity history
loadError.description: The filters may be invalid or the activity-log service is currently unavailable.
